turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me.
I didn't come here to be flattered. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Owen's luck isn't on the table. I asked who decided on the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
I really respect how much you care.
Respect isn't what I'm here for. Answer the question.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on a team. Who decided on the zero?
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
That's the fourth compliment, Hale. Do you have a single document, or is this the whole meeting?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that his record stays clean; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no document, no dates and nothing tied to Owen's own work, and without evidence she has no reason to give any ground.
What cost ground: You answered her question about who decided on the zero with a string of compliments, which told her you had no process or proof to stand on and made her harder each time.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, answer in one sentence, own that it went in before you called her, and then put a dated document in front of her.
